full_page.content:
1935, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Francis Dorr - 28 - stomach ulcers, given up last Sunday but improv- ing since enrolled - 3 blood transfusions.
Page 59 Oct. 21 Page 60 Mrs. Mabel Benito - 32 - of Windsor, has husband & 2 small ch. - ab- cess on liver and intestinal cancers. Drs. have no hope.
Oct 24 26 Charles Swaney - 28 - Epileptic now 3 yrs. - has wife and 2 small - keep .... in anxiety .... promises weekly Communion and Enrollment if able to work.
Rose Rivard - 62 - Stomach & Intest Tr.
Kasimira Stachowska - 42 - fears sarcomic (blood) cancer ... operation few yrs. ago now worse than ever.
Mary E. Vigeon - 18 - Epileptic almost two yrs. - was enrolled in Sept. 10th - yr. and afterward a perpetual member - improved since. Came with mother To-day from Toronto, Canada. Enrolled To-day again perpetually - proposes to give donation if cured $100.
Blank Page.
Page 61 Page 62 Oct. 29 Rt. Rev. Monsg. McCarthy - liver - kidney 29 Laura Wendel - 40 - complication unconscious since last Saturday. Clara Antosewicz - 36 - Cancer of breast and spine.
Mary Ellen Ault - 48 - trained nurse - sinus and intestinal trouble Nov. 4 "Report" Remarkably improved .... Deo Gr.
30 Nellie Sulliban - 33 - uncertain about vocation - undecided
30 Noreen Mulcahy - 30 - double pneumonia. Drs. have little hope.
Leonard Anteau - 30 - has been sent north T.B. feared, has wife and 2 small children.
Josephine Plank - 48 - abcess on liver - was going to doctor every 2nd day - expected operation. Prayed for 3 weeks ago and enrolled. Now quite OK. no operation necessary.
Page 63 Blank Page.
